name: total_raised_usd
description: Total capital raised; largest of announced rounds, filings (Form D, priced SH01) and the PDL aggregate. All candidates kept in evidence.

name: round_count
description: Number of distinct funding rounds (allotments within 90 days merged).

name: last_round_date
description: Date of the most recent round from any source.

name: last_round_type
description: Stage of the most recent announced round.

name: months_since_last_round
description: Months from the last round to the as-of date.

name: no_round_24m
description: 1 if no round in the last 730 days: the paper's 'longtime' failure rule.

name: median_months_between_rounds
description: Median gap between consecutive rounds (funding speed).

name: funding_velocity_usd_per_year
description: Total raised divided by company age.

name: latest_price_per_share
description: Price paid per share in the latest priced allotment (UK SH01).

name: implied_post_money
description: Latest priced allotment price x total shares after it (UK SH01).

name: valuation_step_up
description: Latest priced share price / previous priced round's price.

name: investor_count
description: Number of investors: Form D count if filed, else distinct investors known.

name: lead_investors
description: Lead investors across rounds.

name: investor_quality_max
description: Best investor tier score (analyst-curated, investor_tiers.json).

name: investor_quality_mean
description: Mean tier score across all known investors.

name: specialist_investor_share
description: Share of investors that are ocean or climate specialists.

name: follow_on_investors
description: Investors appearing in more than one round of this startup.

name: founder_count
description: Founders: directors appointed within 30 days of incorporation (UK), else beneficial owners.

name: serial_founder_count
description: Founders who directed another company before this one was incorporated.

name: prior_ventures_total
description: Companies the founders directed before this one.

name: prior_ventures_failed
description: Of those, how many are dissolved, liquidated or in administration.

name: founder_retention
description: Share of founders still serving as directors.

name: officer_churn
description: Resigned officers / all officers ever appointed.

name: category_tags
description: Tags used for peer similarity: sector, industry, YC tags, SIC codes, ocean impact areas, keywords.

name: top_peer
description: Most similar startup in the DB by weighted tag overlap.

name: headcount
description: Latest employee count.

name: open_roles
description: Open job postings matched to the company.

name: news_mentions_12m
description: News items naming the company in the last 12 months.

name: allotments_last_12m
description: UK share allotments in the last 12 months (raise cadence; often precedes announcements).

name: patent_count
description: Patents assigned to the company.

name: patents_granted
description: Of those, how many are granted.

name: grant_share
description: Share of announced funding that is non-dilutive (grants).

name: company_age_years
description: Years since founding (curated year, else earliest registry date).

name: distress_flag
description: 1 if insolvency case, administration/liquidation status, or no active officers.

name: registry_status
description: Registered company status.

name: funding_total_spread
description: Max/min ratio between independent total-raised figures (1 = sources agree).

name: founded_year_conflicts
description: Distinct founded-year values across sources, including the curated one.

name: down_round_flag
description: 1 if any priced round was below the previous round's price (UK SH01).

name: founder_other_ventures
description: All other companies the founders direct or directed, any date (side projects, spin-outs, next venture).

name: eu_grants_total_eur
description: EU research/innovation funding received (sum of the company's own EU contribution, CORDIS).

name: eu_projects_count
description: EU-funded projects the company takes part in (any role).

name: eu_projects_funded
description: Of those, projects where the company itself receives EU money.

name: eu_coordinator_count
description: EU projects the company coordinates (leadership signal).

name: eu_first_grant_year
description: Start year of the company's first EU project.

name: eu_active_projects
description: EU projects currently running (signed, end date in the future).

name: eic_or_sme_instrument
description: 1 if funded by the EIC or the H2020 SME Instrument: highly selective startup programmes.

name: mission_ocean_grant
description: 1 if part of the EU Mission 'Restore our Ocean and Waters'.

name: eu_consortium_links
description: Total consortium partners across the company's EU projects (network reach; partners in several projects count each time).

name: cordis_sme_confirmed
description: 1 if CORDIS records the company as an SME.

name: grant_to_equity_ratio
description: EU grants / total raised: grant dependency, typical for ocean deep tech.

name: ocean_patent_count
description: Patents with at least one ocean-technology CPC class (aquaculture, seaweed, algae products, ocean energy, vessels, ship emissions, cleanup, ocean sensing).

name: ocean_patent_share
description: Ocean-class patents / patents with known classes. Misses marine-use patents filed in generic classes.

name: ocean_tech_groups
description: Ocean technology groups found in the company's patent classes.

name: blueinvest_listed
description: 1 if the company is in the EU BlueInvest Project Pipeline (investor-facing showcase); 0 if not found.

name: blueinvest_trl
description: Self-reported TRL on the BlueInvest profile.

name: blueinvest_funding_sought_eur
description: Funding sought according to the BlueInvest profile (largest EUR amount in its financial needs text).

name: blueinvest_sector
description: BlueInvest blue-economy sector.

name: trl_gap
description: Self-reported TRL (BlueInvest) minus the seed TRL estimate; large gaps need checking.

name: board_size
description: Current directors / board members (Companies House directors, SEC Form D directors, PDL board titles).

name: technical_open_roles
description: Open engineering / science / R&D roles.

name: commercial_open_roles
description: Open sales / business development / marketing / customer roles.

name: blueinvest_peer_count
description: Similar companies in the EU BlueInvest pipeline (similarity >= 0.1): competitor density.

name: peer_median_trl
description: Median TRL of the 10 most similar BlueInvest companies.

name: trl_vs_peers
description: Own TRL (BlueInvest if listed, else seed estimate) minus the peer median TRL.

name: first_patent_granted
description: Was the company's first utility patent application granted? 1 granted, 0 abandoned/refused; 'pending' while undecided; 'unknown' for international (WO) filings, which never grant themselves (needs family data). Patent 'lottery' paper: first-patent approval predicts later funding and growth.

name: first_patent_months_to_grant
description: Months from filing to grant for the first utility patent. Mostly reflects the patent office (EPO ~5 years, USPTO less): compare within one office.

name: patents_pending
description: Patent applications still pending.

name: patents_abandoned
description: Applications abandoned, withdrawn, refused or lapsed for non-payment (WO 'ceased' excluded: it only ends the international phase).
